title: Skeletal muscle mass and inflammation-based prognostic score as prognostic factors in oral cancer
html: Tumour-related malnutrition and impaired oral intake contribute to skeletal muscle loss in patients with oral cancer. The aim of this study was to examine the impact of pre-treatment skeletal muscle mass (SMM) and inflammation-based prognostic score (IBPS) on the prognosis of oral squamous cell carcinoma (OSCC). A total of 285 patients who underwent curative treatment for OSCC between 2010 and 2019 were included. SMM was evaluated as the cross-sectional area of the bilateral sternocleidomastoid muscles at the third cervical vertebra level (C3).
